place: Bophut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Three- or Four-Bedroom Rooftop Pool Villas near Fisherman's Village
blurb: Choose your plot, then your villa: a three-bedroom family home of about 300 m² or a four-bedroom of about 460 m², each with a private pool, sauna and rooftop terrace, in an eight-villa enclave minutes from Fisherman's Village in Bophut. Off-plan from ฿12,200,000.
detail:
A boutique enclave of eight private pool villas in Bophut, on Koh Samui's lively north coast — a few minutes from the restaurants, boutiques and Friday night market of Fisherman's Village and the calm sands of Bophut Beach, with the ring road and airport close at hand. Six of the eight plots are offered with a choice of two villa designs, so buyers pick the plot first and then the home that suits them.

Both designs share the same warm, contemporary language: crisp white walls, timber detailing, natural stone and floor-to-ceiling glass that slides back onto a covered terrace and a private swimming pool. Each villa sits behind its own boundary wall and gate, with a sauna, outdoor shower, covered parking for two cars and a rooftop sun terrace looking out over the treetops to the hills.

TWO DESIGNS, SAME PLOTS
Three-bedroom villa — a two-storey family home of about 300 m² (structure area), with three bathrooms, a 19 m² living room opening to a 23 m² kitchen, a 41 m² ground-floor terrace, a private fitness room and a 23 m² rooftop sundeck.

Four-bedroom villa — the largest configuration at about 460 m², adding a fourth bedroom and a fourth bathroom, a larger 26 m² living room and 34 m² kitchen, terraces of 46 m² below and 23 m² above, a bigger pool (about 8 × 3.5 m), and a 43.5 m² rooftop terrace with an outdoor kitchen. Ideal for larger families, or for owners looking at holiday-rental income.

PRICE PER PLOT (THB, leasehold)
Plot 1 · 384.8 m² land — 3-bed ฿12,500,000 · 4-bed ฿14,500,000
Plot 2 · 354 m² land — 3-bed ฿12,200,000 · 4-bed ฿14,200,000
Plot 3 · 354 m² land — 3-bed ฿12,200,000 · 4-bed ฿14,200,000
Plot 4 · 384.8 m² land — 3-bed ฿12,500,000 · 4-bed ฿14,500,000
Plot 5 · 354 m² land — 3-bed ฿12,200,000 · 4-bed ฿14,200,000
Plot 6 · 354 m² land — 3-bed ฿12,200,000 · 4-bed ฿14,200,000

Freehold is available for an additional ฿800,000 on any plot, for Thai nationals or eligible Thai-owned companies.

PAYMENT & OWNERSHIP
A staged payment plan runs from reservation to key handover: a ฿250,000 reservation fee (credited against the land payment), the balance of the land price on transfer, a construction deposit, then instalments tied to building milestones — structure, walls, ceilings, tiling, pool and finishing — with the final payment at handover. Land transfer fees are shared equally between buyer and seller.
